PWA (Progressive Web App) Development Services

Let Mobilunity’s tech adepts combine native apps’ functionality with the accessibility of web apps in PWAs. Let professionals ensure their synchronization with Odoo’s CRM, inventory, and sales modules.

HRMS (Human Resource Management System) Development

Accounting Integration

Engage our developers with years of experience in Odoo to contribute to linking your resource planning platform with top external accounting systems. Let them synchronize your financial data and improve decision-making.

IoT Integration

Let a team of skilled Odoo specialists assist you in enhancing business operations through IoT. It will allow data exchange between machines, sensors, and other Odoo units, such as manufacturing and inventory.

Third-Party Logistics (3PL) Integration

Get professional support in connecting your enterprise software with logistics providers by contracting Mobilunity’s engineers. They’ll help you automate order tracking, inventory updates, delivery management, and more.

Social Media Integration

Benefits of Hiring Odoo Developers With Us

Certified ERP Developers

Our recruiters find candidates who are a perfect technical match for the role. They vet certified developers possessing expertise in Odoo frameworks and modules and an understanding of its best practices. On average, they need 2.5 interviews to close a vacancy.

Competitive (Up to 2X Lower) Prices

We access an international talent pool of developers with extensive knowledge of Odoo. So with Mobilunity, you can recruit tech adepts from countries with lower living costs and salaries yet strong STEM skills and save up to 50% of development costs.

Focus on Your Business Needs

The growth and sustainability of our partners are fundamental to our success. Therefore, Mobilunity remains sensitive to your business priorities and is ready to adapt our cooperation format to meet your project requirements and budget needs.

Proactive and Clear Communication

Your prompt feedback is crucial for recruiting and retaining your Odoo engineers. Therefore, we aim for 100% transparency in communication and approach it proactively, promoting a healthy and collaborative environment.

Managed Back-Office Tasks

As we onboard your engineers, we take on all the administrative issues related to their work. From legal and accounting to regular 1:1s and team-building activities, Mobilunity handles back-office tasks to maintain your focus on the project.

Hiring in Under 6 Weeks

While hiring a dedicated Odoo developer in Western Europe or the USA can take months, contracting offshore or nearshore engineers typically takes our recruiters around 6 weeks. You can significantly decrease the ERP’s time-to-go-live and time-to-value for your organization.

FAQs

How much does it cost to hire an Odoo developer with Mobilunity?

The cost of hiring an Odoo developer depends on their seniority, location, and our cooperation format. Book a free consultation to get the estimate. 

What key skills should an ERP engineer possess?

A seasoned engineer should be proficient in Python, familiar with JavaScript, XML, and SQL for customizations and integrations, and experienced in PostgreSQL for database management. They should also have competence in ORM framework and module development, be familiar with Odoo’s web and backend architecture, and know how to integrate Odoo with external systems and APIs.

Do you assist with technical interviews for my candidates?

Sure, we offer technical interviews as a service. We engage developers with extensive experience with Odoo to assess your candidates’ hard skills.

How can I ensure I hire the best Odoo developers for my project?

Mobilunity’s tech recruiters thoroughly explore your project requirements. They use proven approaches to find and vet certified professionals who perfectly fit the role. So, we contract only high-quality developers, and 93% of the pass-probation rate confirms this.

What should I consider when hiring off-site Odoo ERP developers?

If you’re looking to hire Odoo developers remotely, it’s vital to ensure effective collaboration between the project managers and certified Odoo experts. Confirm that they use relevant communication tools, set clear goals that align with your business objectives, and schedule regular check-ins. The ability to work autonomously is also vital for keeping your project on track.

What other services do your developers provide?

They handle complex Odoo customizations, build new modules, containerize Odoo applications and dependencies using Docker, and create efficient and user-friendly Odoo POS and mobile apps using advanced programming.

Which industries are your ERP engineers proficient in?

Mobilunity’s engineers provide Odoo ERP services for businesses from diverse domains. These include retail, e-commerce, manufacturing, logistics, finance, healthcare, real estate, hospitality, and education.

Is Mobilunity an Odoo partner?

Mobilunity isn’t an Odoo Gold, Silver, or Ready partner since we aren’t a company specializing in implementing, customizing, and supporting Odoo systems. Instead, Mobilunity is a tech team provider that helps you engage professionals who can deploy, configure, and maintain Odoo solutions.
